title: Add a window to the kitchen (no size or wall given)
prompt: Add a window to the kitchen.

assertions.label: ask, or add one window to a kitchen exterior wall

notes: Ambiguous on purpose: no wall and no size. Asking is right; so is adding one window to one of the kitchen's exterior walls.

references.label: asks
references.reply: Which wall would you like it on — the north wall, or the east wall facing the yard — and what size?

references.label: picks the east wall and says so
references.reply: I added a 36 x 36 window centred on the east wall, matching the existing kitchen window.
